text: {"lessons":["Recent price movements have not reliably predicted what comes next, so I should avoid trading on short-term trends.","Selling part of Stock A after a large gain and adding to other stocks helped diversify my holdings; I should base such decisions on my overall allocation, not just a position’s average cost.","I should keep reviewing my portfolio deliberately and trade only when a decision fits my risk tolerance and long-term plan, rather than reacting to ordinary account fluctuations."]}
